acceptance_condition: Satisfy every assigned whole-task demand and explicit constraint.
rationale: The whole task submitted after intake.
text: Produce a 1,400–1,800 word architecture decision memo that commits to one concrete, implementable design for a shared knowledge substrate serving recursively decomposing AI research agents: questions and answers modeled as first-class many-to-many graph objects; the design compared against an open conversational forum and against no inter-agent communication; full specification of the data model and invariants, staged visibility and communication protocol, persistence and concurrent-update semantics, contradiction and belief-revision behavior, retrieval/ranking, and the exact role of model versus runtime; evidence restricted to the seven-file workspace corpus with at least five distinct source files cited via PDF page markers; the corpus's conflicting empirical conclusions reconciled rather than hidden; source-supported claims distinguished from design inferences; and a falsifiable evaluation plan (at least three conditions, five named metric families) plus explicit limitations and unresolved questions.
